correctness.rationale: Proof verified: on each cell the exact mass-matrix normal equations give traces A=(1-t)(1-3t), B=(1-t)(1+3t); the piecewise quadratic edge and interior trace-inclusive jump variation norms maximize at 16/9 and 2, with one-cell 3/2. Distributional derivative jump representation and triangle inequality extend the estimate from step functions to all BV inputs. Exact rational checker verifies 98 normal-equation positions, 1790 step cases and 2400 signed multijump tests, none substituted for the infinite-input analytic proof. Mesh grading cancels by affine cell rescaling.

value.rationale: The full distributional BV norm including interelement jumps is the natural stability measure for discontinuous degree-one finite-element projection. The sharp mesh-independent values 3/2,16/9,2 distinguish one, two and three or more cells and are simultaneously exact for arbitrary nonuniform meshes, with attainable step extremizers. This gives concrete worst-case variation calibration and a structural contrast with TV-diminishing continuous interpolation. It is not a renaming or a trivial slice of a preexisting full-coverage statement.
